timeline.event: checkout service deployed config_v42 with EU tax endpoint mapping change
tax service request failed with region mismatch for eu-order
retry failed: tax endpoint us-east cannot serve eu tax quote
errors returned to baseline after rollback completed

root_cause: Checkout service config_v42 deployment with incorrect EU tax endpoint mapping causing region mismatch
why_it_happened: A config change at 09:14 switched EU tax endpoint mapping incorrectly
This caused EU checkout requests to be routed to us-east endpoint which cannot serve EU tax quotes
Resulting in tax calculation errors for all EU checkout requests
ruled_out_hypotheses: Payment gateway outage (gateway was healthy per logs)
Database pool exhaustion (would present as pool timeout saturation, not region mismatch)
immediate_mitigation: Rollback checkout config to last known good version (config_v41)
